messages:
Rae: Heads-upI put up a quick mock for a 'normalized cost per 1k tokens' card that also shows amortized cache savings. Wanted feedback before I wire it to real telemetry.
Nikhil: Nice. Two quick asks: show both estimated and reconciled values, and include a small sparkline for sampling rate so folks know data fidelity.
Rae: Good call. The mock currently shows a small badge: (est) or (reconciled) next to the main number. Sparkline for sampling rate sounds useful.
Priya: On the data model - if we show amortized cache we need a consistent definition. Do we credit savings to the route that warmed the cache or the route that consumed it? That affects per-route economics.
Nikhil: We discussed last-writer wins earlier. But for UX, customers usually care about what they were charged, so credit to consumer route (the one that got the saved tokens) makes sense. For internal chargebacks we can run a different reconciliation and show "origin credits" in a detailed view.
Clara: Agreed. For console rollouts we should default to consumer-applied amortization. Add a tooltip explaining origin credits are in the advanced billing tab.
Rae: Implementation question: our telemetry currently has cache_hit boolean and token_count. Would it be OK to add cache_credit_estimate (int) and cache_lineage_hash (string) so ingestion can later reconcile?
Nikhil: Yep. But watch cardinality of lineage hashes in ClickHouse. Strategy: emit full hash but store only a 64-bit truncated hash in the hot table. Put full hash in object logs for backfill.
Priya: Sampling: for routes with >1M calls/day we sample 1% by default. That makes 99th percentile math messy. Can we add a dynamic-sampling flag when a route is under canary so we temporarily increase sample rate?
Nikhil: We can. benji-bot: sampling-rate-update scheduled: route=ai-assistant-canary -> 10% by Nikhil.
Clara: UX nit: in the card header show "Effective cost (1k tokens)" then a caret to expand to raw numbers. If users expand, show columns: raw_tokens, cache_credit, model_multiplier, estimated_flag.
Rae: Good. Also adding a small "confidence" meter (low/med/high) computed from sampling rate + backfill recency.
Priya: For the model/unit econ view, let's normalize all models to "1k token equivalent" and show an adjustable quantization weight per model variant so teams can see impact of quantization levels.
Nikhil: Tech task list: 1) proto bump to include cache_credit_estimate + lineage_hash, 2) ingest truncated hash into hot tables, full hash to cold logs, 3) backfill job to reconcile top prefixes daily, 4) dashboard feature flag per-tenant.
Rae: I'll attach the mock in the PR and add copy for the tooltip. Priya can you write a short blurb for PMs explaining est vs reconciled numbers?
Priya: On it. Also propose we show a small "last reconciled" timestamp on the card so users know when numbers were finalized.
benji-bot: created epic PLAT-8342: cache-credit-reconciliation and task PLAT-8343: proto-change.
Rae: Timeline: prototype UI + estimated numbers -> internal demo Wed. Proto + ingest changes by end of week if no blockers. Thanks all.
